spans.s: नृ-शृंग n. man’s horn, i.e. an impossible thing.
नृ-सिंह m. 1. an eminent man; 2. Viṣṇu in his fourth incarnation; 3. a particular mode of coition.
नृ-सेन n. an army of men.
नृ-सेना f. an army of men.
नृ-सोम m. an illustrious man, a great man, R.v.59.
नृशंस a. (f. सा) Malicious, cruel, wicked, mischievous, Yaj.i.164.
नृशंस a. (f. सा) Malicious, cruel, wicked, mischievous, Yaj.i.164.
